common.tagline: Ancient Ordnance Regional Depot world — now a galaxy-famous criminal port.
common.government: Mantellian planetary council (corrupt; bought by syndicates)
common.famousFor: Bounty hunters. Smugglers. The Worlport black markets. More wanted notices on its boards than any other Mid Rim world.
common.cantinaReputation: Sprawling junkyard world turned trading hub. In 15 BBY, Ord Mantell is a haven for bounty hunters, scrappers, and black marketeers. The capital city's open-air bazaars sell everything from stolen blasters to forged identchips. Cheap fuel, cheaper morals — just watch your credits.
